prompt:
You maintain a running summary of a long engineering document that is being read part by part, so that a later reader can model the system in SysML v2 without seeing the earlier parts.
Update the summary with the new part. Keep, as compactly as possible: the full names of system elements, actors and items; every alias or call sign with the full name it stands for; which element produces, sends or receives which item; modes and normative requirements. At most 300 words.

Current summary:
Boundary: receiving to outbound release. Elements/aliases: Inbound Inspection Desk=Cinderbay (checks paperwork, trailer ID/seals, damage; consumes Oversize Load Advisory; records proceed/rework/hold; sends Trailer Seal Exception Note to Yard Gate Controller). Pallet Dimension Scanner=Moonquarry (checks profiles vs configured limits, flags out-of-tolerance; produces Oversize Load Advisory, not placement authorization). Inbound Pallet Buffer (staging only; unavailable if path crosses recovery area). North Aisle Stacker Crane=Juniperwake (sends Aisle Occupancy Snapshot to WMS; uses Slot Reservation Receipt; verifies aisle clear before resuming, stops on obstruction/invalid path; reports faults). South Aisle Stacker Crane (reduced-speed recovery maneuver). East/West Transfer Conveyors (stopped if compromising boundary; East restart: empty, reduced speed, one full cycle before pallet). Conveyor Line Controller=Brasshaven (produces Transfer Induction Ticket to Forklift Fleet; holds uncertain/duplicate transfers; inhibits feed if restart cycle incomplete or protective device changes state). Autonomous Forklift Fleet=Larkspur (receives Transfer Induction Ticket, validates destination vs route; produces Forklift Handoff Confirmation; hold near recovery area). Yard Gate Controller=Velvetrook (validates arrivals, assigns doors, holds vehicles outside boundary). Outbound Dispatch Sorter (receives Dispatch Wave Amendment). Outbound Checkweigh Scale (Gross Weight Variance Slip; reference-load check at shift start and after maintenance). Shipping Documentation Desk. Safety Zone Controller (applies Sprinkler Zone Inhibit Notice from Fire Alarm Panel by maintaining exclusion boundary until release criteria); both keep stop authority. Maintenance Release Terminal=Copperfield (Crane Service Release Card; status checked before return to automatic). Warehouse Management System=Morrowglass (authoritative; releases work, plans waves, Dispatch Wave Amendment, Slot Reservation Receipt; reconciles locations before recovery plan; records transaction times, reconciles movements vs shift plan). Actors: Warehouse Operations Supervisor (verifies personnel clear; reconciles holds before normal work; shift-start review of alarms/equipment/unresolved work; confirms operators know speed limits, boundaries, stop criteria; compares downtime vs event records); drivers, receiving, yard, maintenance, spotter. Modes: crane available/fault/inhibited/recovery; pallet held/rework/proceed. Requirements: valid receipt; seals before unloading; dimensional exceptions held, no assumed measurement; failed test keeps inhibited; no work without WMS release; recovery

New part:
S217: At handover, the outgoing shift records equipment restrictions, pending checks, and unresolved safety concerns.
S218: The incoming shift acknowledges those conditions before authorizing routine movements.
S219: Commissioning acceptance is conducted against an approved test plan before routine warehouse operation begins.
S220: The test plan defines expected behavior, safety limits, evidence requirements, and criteria for blocking release.
S221: Each subsystem is exercised under representative loads, including recovery from interrupted transactions and controlled equipment stops.
S222: The Warehouse Operations Supervisor confirms that acceptance evidence is complete and that any remaining limitations are documented.
S223: The Warehouse Management System is checked for inventory accuracy, transaction integrity, and correct handling of unavailable storage locations.
S224: Acceptance is withheld when a material defect could compromise personnel safety, inventory control, or shipment accuracy.
S225: The Warehouse Management System uses the handoff confirmation to close the applicable movement record.
S226: The Shipping Documentation Desk receives and reconciles the Gross Weight Variance Slip against the applicable shipment record before completing its paperwork.
S227: A scale variance outside the approved tolerance is investigated and resolved before the affected shipment is released.
S228: The North Aisle Stacker Crane accepts the release card as authorization to return to service after its checks are complete.
S229: A crane remains unavailable for automated assignments until its functional checks and required safety checks have passed.
S230: Morrowglass closes the commissioning action register only after unresolved findings have named owners and due dates.
S231: Cinderbay records governance approval and confirms that the accepted operating configuration is under change control.
S232: Brasshaven verifies that conveyor zones are clear and records the completion of its assigned closing checks.
S233: Larkspur parks its vehicles in approved locations and reports any remaining equipment restrictions for the next shift.
S234: Copperfield records completed service work and confirms that equipment restrictions remain visible until formally cleared.
S235: The Fire Alarm Panel is checked for active faults, bypasses, and indications requiring escalation before the facility is released.
S236: The Safety Zone Controller is verified against the approved access boundaries and stop-response behavior.
S237: The Inbound Inspection Desk and Outbound Dispatch Sorter confirm that their operating interfaces are available and that exceptions can be held safely.
S238: Changes to software, equipment settings, or operating procedures require an impact review, approval, and a controlled implementation record.
S239: Emergency changes are documented promptly and reviewed by the Warehouse Operations Supervisor before normal operation resumes.

Return JSON {"summary": "..."}.
